# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'digest'
require 'json'
require 'fileutils'
require 'pathname'

module BlockchainContract
  class ContractDeployer
    ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = %w[.wasm .sol .vy].freeze
    MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024 # 10MB
    UPLOAD_BASE = '/var/contracts/deployed'

    attr_reader :chain_config, :deployment_registry

    def initialize(env: ENV)
      @chain_config = load_chain_config(env)
      @deployment_registry = {}
      @nonce_counter = 0
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(UPLOAD_BASE) unless Dir.exist?(UPLOAD_BASE)
    end

    def deploy_contract(sender:, contract_file:, constructor_args: {})
      validate_sender!(sender)
      metadata = extract_metadata(contract_file)
      sanitized_path = resolve_upload_path(metadata)
      
      verify_file_integrity!(contract_file, metadata)
      write_contract(contract_file, sanitized_path)
      
      contract_address = generate_address(sender, @nonce_counter)
      @nonce_counter += 1
      
      register_deployment(contract_address, sanitized_path, sender, metadata)
      { address: contract_address, status: :deployed, path: sanitized_path }
    end

    private

    def load_chain_config(env)
      {
        network_id: env.fetch('CHAIN_NETWORK_ID', '1'),
        strict_mode: env.fetch('CONTRACT_STRICT_MODE', 'true'),
        allowed_deployers: env.fetch('ALLOWED_DEPLOYERS', '').split(','),
        path_resolution: env.fetch('PATH_RESOLUTION_MODE', 'canonical'),
        sandbox_enabled: env.fetch('SANDBOX_ENABLED', 'true')
      }
    end

    def validate_sender!(sender)
      return if chain_config[:allowed_deployers].empty?
      unless chain_config[:allowed_deployers].include?(sender)
        raise SecurityError, "Sender #{sender} not in allowed deployers list"
      end
    end

    def extract_metadata(contract_file)
      filename = contract_file[:filename]
      content = contract_file[:content]
      ext = File.extname(filename).downcase

      {
        original_name: filename,
        extension: ext,
        size: content.bytesize,
        checksum: Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(content),
        timestamp: Time.now.to_i
      }
    end

    def resolve_upload_path(metadata)
      base_name = File.basename(metadata[:original_name], metadata[:extension])
      safe_name = sanitize_filename(base_name)
      
      if chain_config[:path_resolution] == 'canonical'
        target = File.join(UPLOAD_BASE, "#{safe_name}_#{metadata[:checksum][0..7]}#{metadata[:extension]}")
        resolve_canonical(target)
      else
        File.join(UPLOAD_BASE, "#{safe_name}_#{metadata[:checksum][0..7]}#{metadata[:extension]}")
      end
    end

    def resolve_canonical(path)
      # In canonical mode, resolve symlinks and normalize
      # But the path doesn't exist yet, so we resolve the parent
      parent = File.dirname(path)
      basename = File.basename(path)
      resolved_parent = File.realpath(parent) rescue parent
      File.join(resolved_parent, basename)
    end

    def sanitize_filename(name)
      # Remove directory traversal attempts
      cleaned = name.gsub(/[\.]{2,}/, '').gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-]/, '_')
      cleaned = 'unnamed' if cleaned.empty?
      cleaned
    end

    def verify_file_integrity!(contract_file, metadata)
      validate_extension!(metadata[:extension])
      validate_size!(metadata[:size])
      validate_content_type!(contract_file, metadata)
    end

    def validate_extension!(ext)
      unless extension_allowed?(ext)
        raise SecurityError, "Extension #{ext} not allowed. Permitted: #{ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS}"
      end
    end

    def extension_allowed?(ext)
      # Always enforce allowlist regardless of strict_mode
      ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS.include?(ext)
    end

    def validate_size!(size)
      if size > MAX_FILE_SIZE
        raise SecurityError, "File size #{size} exceeds maximum #{MAX_FILE_SIZE}"
      end
      if size == 0
        raise SecurityError, "Empty contract files not allowed"
      end
    end

    def validate_content_type!(contract_file, metadata)
      content = contract_file[:content]
      ext = metadata[:extension]

      case ext
      when '.wasm'
        unless content[0..3] == "\x00asm"
          raise SecurityError, "Invalid WASM magic bytes"
        end
      when '.sol'
        unless content.include?('pragma') || content.include?('contract')
          raise SecurityError, "Invalid Solidity content"
        end
      end
    end

    def write_contract(contract_file, path)
      # Always use sandboxed writing
      write_sandboxed(contract_file[:content], path)
    end

    def write_sandboxed(content, path)
      # Verify the final path is within UPLOAD_BASE
      canonical_base = File.realpath(UPLOAD_BASE) rescue UPLOAD_BASE
      path_to_check = File.expand_path(path)
      
      unless path_to_check.start_with?(canonical_base + '/')
        raise SecurityError, "Path traversal detected: #{path} resolves outside sandbox"
      end
      
      File.write(path, content, mode: 'wb')
    end

    def generate_address(sender, nonce)
      raw = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest("#{sender}:#{nonce}:#{Time.now.to_i}")
      "0x#{raw[0..39]}"
    end

    def register_deployment(address, path, sender, metadata)
      @deployment_registry[address] = {
        path: path,
        deployer: sender,
        metadata: metadata,
        deployed_at: Time.now.to_i
      }
    end
  end
end
